metadata.method: Split original geometry against flat-ended buffers around parallel segments in the other period. Classified source observations retained but hidden. Three display features dissolve exact duplicates within each class; shared display uses 1930s geometry. No snapping or historical date inference.
metadata.limitations: Near-parallel tracks within five metres can match. Larger digitizing offsets may appear period-only. Exact 1930s snapshot remains uncertain.
